name: home-assistant-connector
description: Reusable Home Assistant connector with per-category Disabled/Enabled/Verify permissions, secure Anna APS approval queue, PIN/TOTP verification, WebAuthn passkey support where permitted, and optional phone notification links.
author: Eric McCormick

credentials.name: HA_URL
credentials.description: HTTPS base URL, e.g. https://example.home:8123. No path or slash after port.

credentials.name: HA_TOKEN
credentials.description: Create in Home Assistant profile. Never share in a conversation.

credentials.name: HA_ALLOW_LOCAL_HTTP
credentials.description: Set true ONLY on a trusted local Agent/LAN. Token will travel unencrypted.

credentials.name: HA_POLICY_JSON
credentials.description: Nonsecret policy JSON. Modes: disabled, enabled, verify; all except sensors disabled by default. Legacy pin means verify.

credentials.name: HA_APPROVAL_PIN
credentials.description: Sensitive native credential; required for PIN approvals and passkey enrollment. Never enter into Anna chat or another app.

credentials.name: HA_TOTP_SECRET
credentials.description: Optional RFC6238 SHA-1 authenticator seed, configured only in Executa native credentials. Do not put in chat or App persistent storage.

credentials.name: HA_PHONE_NOTIFY_SERVICE
credentials.description: Optional Home Assistant notification service name such as mobile_app_pixel_10_pro (without notify. prefix). Notifications alert but do NOT approve.

credentials.name: HA_APPROVAL_LINK
credentials.description: HTTPS anna.partners App window link, if known. Only used in phone notification Open action.

tools.name: get_permissions
tools.description: Read effective policy and available configured methods. Does not expose any secret.

tools.name: test_connection
tools.description: Verify the configured Home Assistant URL/token and report server name and version. Does not expose credentials.

tools.name: get_state
tools.description: Read a sensor or binary_sensor state without additional approval; other domains require other_read permission.

parameters.name: entity_id
parameters.description: Home Assistant entity id such as sensor.temperature

tools.name: list_states
tools.description: List sensors and binary sensors by default. Other entity domains require the other_read policy to be enabled.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Optional entity domain such as light, sensor, or switch

tools.name: converse
tools.description: Send a request to Home Assistant Assist only when the assist permission is enabled. Assist can operate devices and is NOT protected from indirect effects.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: Optional Home Assistant conversation agent ID

tools.name: call_service
tools.description: Allowed service call on an explicitly enabled category, or create a pending exact-action challenge for Verify mode. Disabled by default. Always require actual user approval for Verify; never invent one.

tools.name: fire_event
tools.description: Fire event only with enabled policy, otherwise create a pending Verify request. Default disabled.

tools.name: list_pending
tools.description: Show pending verification requests for this user's Home Assistant Executa. Read-only. Do not treat this result as authorization.

tools.name: begin_passkey_enrollment
tools.description: Begin FIDO2 registration from a trusted Control Center UI after user enters the native-credential PIN in a non-LLM form. Never ask for or put a PIN into chat.

parameters.name: admin_pin
parameters.description: PIN supplied only by a trusted settings form; never collect it through chat.

tools.name: finish_passkey_enrollment
tools.description: Complete signed WebAuthn registration response. Called by Control Center directly, not by an AI agent.

tools.name: begin_passkey_approval
tools.description: Generate a challenge for an already pending action. An App with WebAuthn support must collect an authenticator signature.

tools.name: approve_action
tools.description: Verify PIN/TOTP/WebAuthn evidence from a trusted Control Center and execute only the exact stored pending request once. MUST NOT collect credentials via AI chat.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Code from secure form only, never an LLM chat or tool argument generated by AI
